element.name: TSynEditBase.TopLine
element.short: Linenumber of the text at the top of the visible area of the editor.

descr.p: The TopLine is the number of the line shown at the top of the visible (scrolled in) area of the Editor.

If the text in that line is wrapped into several sub-lines, then the first visible sub-line can be any of them. It does not have to be the first sub-line. Some of the wrapped sub-lines may be outside the visible area. TopLine does not indicate which wrapped sub-line is at the top.

element.name: TSynEditBase.BottomLine
element.short: Linenumber of the text at the bottom of the visible area of the editor. (Excluding the clipped partially visible line)

element.name: TSynEditBase.PartialBottomLine
element.short: Linenumber of the text at the bottom of the visible area of the editor. (Including the clipped partially visible line)
